reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of radiation-induced precipitation by targeting incipient Cr/V segregations through a solution anneal and quench, a physically sound mechanism for homogenizing a single-phase BCC alloy. It is specific, testable, and grounded in established metallurgical principles without relying on unsupported precise values, whereas Hypothesis B introduces Hf without clear evidence that it suppresses Cr/V diffusion in this system and cites conflicting evidence (E3) that undermines its mechanism.
